question: Can the verified R3 descriptive outputs be displayed as readable article figures with conditions, actual animal counts and direct paired endpoints?
decision: Publish readable local scientific figures with explicit endpoint limits; repair the observed Figure 4 legend/x-label overlap without recalculating RNA results.
strongest_rival: Layout collision or ambiguous condition labels prevents the reader from distinguishing samples, paired responses and descriptive means.
discriminator: Render only frozen coordinates and individual-animal gene tables; inspect both final PNG plates for readable labels, units and sample counts.
exposure_record: All R3 descriptive v2 outcomes and original rendered figures are exposed. Figure 4 has an observed x-label/legend collision. This is a layout-only correction.
biological_unit: Source animal label scoped to its GEO series; matched treatment cultures within animal.
nesting_and_overlap: GSE162300: 36 sequencing columns collapse to 18 libraries in three animal labels; GSE162382: 28 libraries in four WT and three conditional-KO labels. Lineages and cultures within animal are repeated measurements. Cross-series identifiers are not paired.
population_and_selection: All deposited genes and all qualified libraries from both series. Twelve display genes fixed before execution: Odc1,Srm,Sms,Sat1,Smox,Pgam1,Ldha,Tpi1,Foxp3,Rorc,Il17a,Kdm6b. No expression-based sample exclusions or outcome-selected genes.
contrast: No new numerical contrast; the same frozen paired response and PCA coordinates are displayed.
endpoint: Two article-style plates in PDF, SVG and 300-dpi PNG with captions and combined PDF.
methods: Load frozen PCA coordinates, selected individual-animal gene changes and summary variance fractions. Re-render using the original plot logic with only Figure 4 bottom margin increased from 0.21 to 0.29. Figure 5 design is unchanged. Validate input row counts. No raw RNA matrix read and no normalization, PCA or statistical analysis rerun.
missingness_and_exclusions: No new sample/gene selections or substitutions; require the original 46 PCA rows and 276 gene-by-animal changes.
multiplicity: No new statistical tests; inherited descriptive display limits apply.
precision_basis: A graphical layout correction adds no biological precision or independent evidence.
interpretation_limit: Relative bulk abundance is not absolute RNA, enzymatic activity, metabolic flux, pathogenicity, fate or formal JMJD3 mediation. The +1 CPM offset affects low-abundance magnitudes. CPM is not TPM or TMM/voom; this initial view does not reproduce the paper limma DEG-selected PCA/programs. Kdm6b gene-level abundance does not verify deletion of the functional exon. No independent biological replication is created.
stop_rule: Stop on input/hash/row-count failures. Visual collisions require another new render version rather than changing frozen figures.
amendment_reason: Layout-only successor for the figure outputs embedded in descriptive v2: separate Figure 4 legend and x-axis label. Numerical v2 remains current and immutable.
